rawFindings.title: Incorrect regex pattern for matching multiple spaces in regular expressions
rawFindings.explanation: The changed regex pattern /( {2,})+?/ no longer correctly captures multiple consecutive spaces in regular expressions for replacement. The previous pattern /( {2,})( [+*{?]|[^+*{?]|$)/ correctly captured multiple spaces followed by certain regex quantifiers or end of string, which is important for accurate detection and fixing.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the regex back to the previous pattern /( {2,})( [+*{?]|[^+*{?]|$)/ to ensure proper matching logic.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Regex with multiple spaces triggers report, but the fix incorrectly replaces only the first part or may miss captures, leading to incorrect or incomplete autofixes.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect usage of regex capture group length for count
rawFindings.explanation: The fix code calculates the count as regexResults[0].length rather than regexResults[1].length. Since the intended match is the first capture group capturing spaces, this change breaks the counting logic used for reporting and autofixing.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change count assignment back to regexResults[1].length to correctly count the number of consecutive spaces matched.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: The reported count of spaces is inaccurate, causing the autofix to use incorrect quantifier numbers (like {0} or unrelated lengths), thus producing invalid regex patterns after autofix.
